sn35.71:2.2: Commentary traces _anassasaṁ_ (variant _anassāsiṁ_) to √_nas_ (perish), which DPD rejects as “unviable”. It is, rather, present participle of _na assasati_, “discouraged, unconsoled”.
sn35.71:5.1: BB has “you should …” but the text has bhavissati. This is unusual in such a context, and I think it is a specific encouragement for the depressed monk. This would be an example of the Buddha’s knowledge of “where all paths lead”.
